answer_2.quote: We report the results in terms of standard metrics from the video-text retrieval literature: mean Average Precision (mAP) and mean F1 score (mF1), where the averages are over words for FVS and over videos for FWS. [...] In addition to mAP and mF1, we also report ranking-based metrics: Precision@N and Recall@N (N=1, 10).
